verdict: Qualcomm set a revenue record at $12.3B, up 5%, on record chip sales — though profit eased 6% to $3.00B and memory shortages clouded the near-term handset outlook.

segments.name: QCT
segments.note: The chip business. Inside it: Handsets $7,824M (+3% YoY), Automotive $1,101M (+15%), IoT $1,688M (+9%).

segments.name: QTL
segments.note: Licensing phone makers to use Qualcomm's patents — very high margin (77% pre-tax).

segments.name: Other and reconciling items
segments.note: QSI strategic investments and corporate items not in QCT or QTL; the difference between segment revenue and the reported total.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building chips, modems and AI platforms; up 10% YoY.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling, legal costs and running the company; up 20% YoY.

otherDetail: Investment and other income, net of $350M, less $169M of interest expense — a net $181M non-operating gain.
oneTimers: Qualcomm completed its acquisition of Alphawave Semi in the quarter, accelerating its expansion into data-center chips.
The Q2 FY26 guidance in this release includes the estimated impact of industry-wide memory supply constraints on several handset customers.
footerNote: Qualcomm's Q2 FY26 guidance in this release reflects expected memory-supply pressure on handset demand.

takeaways.title: A record quarter
takeaways.text: Revenue hit a record $12.25B, up 5% — and QCT chip revenue set its own record at $10.61B.

takeaways.title: Cars keep climbing
takeaways.text: Automotive chip revenue topped $1B for a second straight quarter, at $1.10B, and IoT grew 9% to $1.69B — diversification beyond phones continued.

takeaways.title: Two profit pictures
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $2.78 against $3.50 non-GAAP — share-based compensation and acquisition items sit in the GAAP column only. GAAP net income eased 6% YoY to $3.00B.

sources.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Dec 28, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)

follow100Note: Rows are rounded to cents, so the waterfall lands a cent below the $24.52 kept as profit.
